title: Ambani's Jio IPO fully subscribed within hours in record Indian sale
paragraphs: Ambani's Jio IPO fully subscribed within hours in record Indian sale
Jio Platforms is home to India's biggest telecom company with more than 500 million subscribers, making it the world's second-largest telecom operator in a single country after China Mobile.

MUMBAI: Jio Platforms' US$3.2 billion IPO was fully subscribed in less than two hours of public bidding on Wednesday (Oct 21), as investors flocked to India's largest share sale and the first from billionaire Mukesh Ambani's Reliance in two decades.
